subject.title: feat(mac): show native notification permission in dashboard Notifications settings

question: Should the embedded macOS Dashboard expose native notification permission, System Settings, and test-notification actions through the new trusted WebKit bridge?
rationale: This PR adds a host-specific user-facing control surface that can initiate native permission and Settings actions; implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the native Dashboard controls
options.body: Accept the host-capability UI after real macOS proof confirms the trusted bridge and permission-recovery flow behave as intended.

options.title: Narrow the capability
options.body: Keep read-only native permission status in the Dashboard but remove permission, Settings, or test-notification actions if the host action boundary is considered too broad.

options.title: Keep browser push only
options.body: Decline the host-specific surface and retain the existing browser web-push settings in all Control UI hosts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the native Dashboard controls
recommendation.body: Accept the host-capability UI after real macOS proof confirms the trusted bridge and permission-recovery flow behave as intended.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context ties this person directly to the proposed macOS Dashboard bridge and its product rationale, though current-main ownership provenance could not be verified locally.
